The '''LCK 2017 Spring''' was the first split of the 2017 [[League of Legends Champions Korea]] season, organized by Riot Games in partnership with OnGameNet and SPOTV. The competition took place in Seoul, South Korea, from January 17 to April 22, 2017, featuring ten teams. The regular season followed a Double Round Robin format with Best-of-Three matches, while the Playoffs used a Single Elimination King of the Hill format with Best-of-Five series from Round 1 onwards. The split offered a ₩275,000,000 KRW prize pool, and the champion qualified for the [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2017|2017 Mid-Season Invitational]]. [[bbq Olivers]] and [[Kongdoo Monster]] joined the league through the [[LCK/2017/Spring/Promotion|Spring Promotion Tournament]]. Matches were played across Patches 7.1 through 7.6.

===Playoffs===
{{ShowBracket|id=LCK17SprPO}}

==Format==
* '''Group Stage'''
** Double Round Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}}
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|''1st place''}} advance to the Finals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|''2nd place''}} advance to the Semifinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|up|''3rd place''}} advance to the Quarterfinals of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|''4th and 6th place''}} advance to the Wild Card Round of the Playoffs.
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|''6th till 8th place''}} qualify for [[LCK/2017/Summer|Summer split]].
*** {{bgcolortext|down|''9th and 10th place''}} will have to play in the [[LCK/2017/Summer/Promotion|Summer Promotion Tournament]].
*'''Playoffs'''
** Single Elimination King of the Hill.
*** Wild Card match is {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
*** Round 1 onwards is {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
* Winner qualifies for [[Mid_Season_Invitational/2017|Mid Season Invitational 2017]]
